title: Intern-AI and Data Solutions
description:
Job Description

What this Department does:

The AI and Data Solutions team designs, develops, integrates, and supports AI-enabled solutions, internal applications, and related services that help Tallgrass teams work more efficiently. The team builds tools such as internal portals, chatbots, workflow automations, and data-informed AI systems, and applies company AI governance, privacy, and security practices throughout delivery.

Interns work alongside developers and data practitioners on structured, supervised assignments. This role is designed for a student still in school: you will learn established patterns, contribute to real backlog and pilot work, and grow toward more independent delivery with mentoring and review.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

You will be part of the AI and Data Solutions team, working with developers on assigned tasks. We give interns meaningful work on real backlog and pilot initiatives, with the supervision and review expected for a student still in school. You will learn current processes, use published documentation and team patterns, and contribute to tools, tests, and documentation that help the team deliver.

You Can Expect To

Join the AI and Data Solutions team on day-to-day work, using published documentation, team patterns, and mentoring to complete assigned tasks.
Help prototype and develop AI-enabled internal tools and automations the team has identified as valuable but cannot currently prioritize against production support and committed delivery work.
Support evaluation, testing, integration, and documentation of AI system workflows, including APIs, model prompts, data inputs, and application components, so senior developers can stay focused on architecture and production releases.
Contribute to data preparation, quality checks, and simple transformations in collaboration with Data & Analytics so datasets are suitable for AI experiments and pilots.
Use AI-assisted development tools to help generate code scaffolding, templates, unit-test stubs, and documentation under established guidelines and review.
Learn introductory retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts - how knowledge sources, prompts, and search support answers - and apply them on assigned exercises under guidance.
Assist in turning business requests into simple technical notes, flow diagrams, and implementation checklists with supervision.
Write and run unit or integration tests for assigned components; record findings, steps, and how-to notes in team documentation.
Apply company AI governance guardrails under direction, including data minimization, PII handling, prompt filtering, content moderation, and privacy and security best practices.
Collaborate with teammates and stakeholders with tact, courtesy, and professionalism; present your work in clear, non-technical language when asked.
Complete other assigned projects that support team delivery and your learning. You will not independently own production systems, on-call rotation, or unsupervised releases.

What You Will Learn

How an enterprise AI and Data Solutions team designs, tests, documents, and delivers AI-enabled applications.
Foundational concepts in large language models (LLMs), generative AI, prompt design, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Practical software engineering habits: version control, code review, testing, and technical documentation.
How data quality, lineage, and responsible data handling affect AI outcomes.
Company AI governance, privacy, and security expectations for internal tools.
How Rapid Application Development (RAD) and AI-assisted coding are used to accelerate delivery under established patterns.
How the broader IT organization works - Applications, Data & Analytics, Infrastructure, and Cyber Security - and how AI solutions fit into that landscape.
How to communicate technical work to both technical and non-technical partners.

Qualifications

What you will bring: (Qualifications)

Education

Student actively enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, and attending related coursework, with an expected graduation date of December 2026-May 2028.

Experience/Specific Knowledge

Coursework or academic project experience in programming, data, or introductory AI/ML concepts.
Foundational familiarity with at least one modern programming language; Python preferred.
Basic understanding of data concepts (tables, files, and introductory SQL or equivalent coursework).
Strong organizational, time-management, written, and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and as part of a team; receptive to feedback and mentoring.
Proficiency in MS Office applications including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Collaborate with a wide variety of people with tact, courtesy, and professionalism.
Maintain a high regard for personal safety, for the safety of company assets and employees, and the general public.

What Makes You Stand Out

Personal, club, or academic projects that used LLMs, chatbots, APIs, notebooks, or simple AI applications.
Familiarity with Git, Python, or introductory web development.
Curiosity about how AI is applied in a business setting, not only in coursework.
Attention to detail, reliability, and a clear desire to learn.
Ability to explain technical ideas in plain language.
Team-oriented mindset and comfort asking questions early.

What Else You Need To Know

Our internships are temporary full-time positions, in-person/hybrid at our Lakewood, CO office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from May-August for 10 weeks.

Compensation And Other Benefits

Pay Range $24.81-$35.15 USD Hourly
The final pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and working location. The total compensation package for this role may also include paid time off, a housing stipend; and more.

About Us

Who are we?

Tallgrass is a leading energy infrastructure company focused on safely, reliably, and sustainably delivering the energy and services that power our nation and enable our quality of life.

What are we known for?

Tallgrass has been recognized consistently over the last 10 years as a Top Workplace, 7 years in Colorado and 3 years in the USA. Tallgrass has also been recognized for its Leadership and Work-Life Flexibility. We are proud to promote Tallgrass as a Top Workplace as we continue to build and nurture an inclusive and rewarding environment.

What do we value?

At Tallgrass, we value our teams and strive to create an environment where employees feel respected, and their contributions are valued. We aim to support our interns' physical, mental, and financial well-being.

What’s in it for you?

At Tallgrass You Will Find

Industry Competitive Pay
Paid Time Off
Career Pathing and Industry Exposure
Access to real world projects that impact our business
Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals in the industry.
A robust internship program that includes trips to our field locations, access to leadership and webinars focused on your skill development.

The Fine Print

Application Deadline: Recruiting timelines vary by position; however, all Tallgrass positions accept applications for at least five business days from the posting date. This position is open and still accepting applications.

Compensation: Compensation ranges are provided in good faith based on what we anticipate when researching wages for this position at the state and national levels. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This salary range may also be modified in the future.

Notice to External Search Firms: Tallgrass does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Unsolicited referrals and resumes are considered Tallgrass property; therefore, Tallgrass will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited referral. Approved vendors may be invited to refer talent for specific positions at Tallgrass's request only. A fully executed agreement with Tallgrass must be in place and current in these cases.

EEO Statement: Tallgrass complies with all Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) affirmative action laws and regulations. Tallgrass does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, religion, color, sex, national origin, marital status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender Identity and expression, disability, veteran status, pregnancy status, or other status protected by law.
